description: Export presets and exports. add_preset writes a preset to export_presets.cfg with the keys the editor's Project > Export writes for a new one and every option a new preset of its platform shows, each at its default, and makes it the platform's runnable preset when the platform has none. set_preset changes a preset's export path, its resource filter and the files it lists, its include and exclude filters, its custom features and its platform's options, and answers under changed what each held before and holds now, and under unchanged what already held the value given, with saved false when that is all of it, since the file is then not written; nothing is written when any of it is refused. The option names are the exporter's own, as the Export dialog's Options tab shows them by their paths, such as binary_format/embed_pck, and a name the platform does not have is refused with the nearest it has, or all of them when none is near. An option the dialog shows only while another is on, such as codesign/identity behind codesign/enable, is taken when the preset has that one on or the same call turns it on, and otherwise refused naming what shows it. A secret option, such as a signing password, is written to .godot/export_credentials.cfg, where the editor keeps secrets out of the committed file, and its value is never answered. A file an option names that is not there is written and listed under missing_files, or for a secret its option under secretsNamingNoFile. remove_preset takes a preset out, and when it was its platform's runnable preset the next of that platform becomes it, under runnableNow, which is null when the platform has no other; a secret it held is taken out with it. It answers where this engine's export templates belong and whether the preset's platform has them, since an export needs them; list says the same for every preset. An editor open on the project does not see a preset added this way until it restarts. run first imports whatever changed on disk since it was imported, named under importedFirst, so the build carries each file as it is now. It answers bytes, the size of the output it wrote, and names, as alsoWritten, what else the export wrote beside its output, such as the .pck a Windows or Linux build cannot start without. Its entries are the errors and warnings the export printed, the newest two hundred distinct ones, one printed more than once carrying times, and errors and warnings count them; exported is true only when this run wrote the output and printed no error. Operations: list: the presets in export_presets.cfg; run (needs preset, outputPath): export with a preset; add_preset (needs preset, platform): add an export preset to export_presets.cfg; set_preset (needs preset): change a preset's path, filters and options; remove_preset (needs preset): take a preset out of export_presets.cfg.

customFeatures.description: set_preset: the custom feature tags the export carries, comma-separated; empty for none. Only for op set_preset.

debug.description: run: a debug export. Default false. Only for op run.

excludeFilter.description: set_preset: the files to leave out, as comma-separated patterns such as "*.txt"; empty for none. Only for op set_preset.

exportFilter.description: set_preset: what the preset exports: every resource, the scenes listed in files and what they use, the resources listed, or every resource but those listed. What a scene or a resource uses is what the engine counts as its dependencies, so a file named only in a string, such as a scene path held in an exported property, or a script reached only by its class_name, is left out of the export, though project_dependencies lists both. Only for op set_preset.

files.description: set_preset: the files the filter lists, as res:// paths; each must be in the project, and for scenes each must be a scene. Only for op set_preset.

includeFilter.description: set_preset: the non-resource files to export too, as comma-separated patterns such as "*.json, data/*"; empty for none. Only for op set_preset.

options.description: set_preset: platform options by name, such as {"binary_format/embed_pck": true, "debug/export_console_wrapper": "No"}. An enum takes the name the dialog shows or its number, and is written as the number. Only for op set_preset.

outputPath.description: Where the export is written, inside the project. The directory is created if it is not there: Godot's command-line exporter refuses a missing one with "The given export path doesn't exist", which reads as a wrong path in the preset. add_preset, set_preset: the path the preset exports to from the editor, optional. Only for ops run, add_preset, set_preset.

pack.description: run: export the resources alone, as a .pck or a .zip by outputPath, which needs no export templates and runs with an engine of the same version. A pack is a release export, so debug is refused beside it. Default false. Only for op run.

platform.description: add_preset: the platform the preset exports for. Only for op add_preset.

preset.description: Preset name from export_presets.cfg. add_preset: the name of the new one. Only for ops run, add_preset, set_preset, remove_preset.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

name: project_export
title: Export
